project.name: BetterAgents-Claude
project.description: Multi-agent orchestration system — AgentX dispatcher, 12-agent ecosystem, Memory Dashboard, session tracking, and 6-pillar safety framework

currentFocus.feature: Dashboard SAFETY tab — Session Activity with prompts + per-file heat-map
currentFocus.objective: Give developers full observability into every Claude Code session: what was asked, which files changed, and how large each change was

technical: Must run in Docker container — no host dependencies beyond jq and Node.js
Dashboard is static HTML served by a Node.js file server — no build step allowed
All memory writes go through .claude/scripts/ helper scripts, never direct file edits
Claude Code hooks (on-session-stop, on-user-prompt, post-tool-use) drive automation
business: MEMORY.md must stay under 200 lines — detailed content goes in topic files
Sub-agents must never write memory files — only AgentX triggers memory writes
Dashboard must work offline — all data loaded from local JSON files

recentChanges.name: Fix: Prompts not rendering in session modal
recentChanges.summary: JSON-in-onclick encoding bug — user prompts with quotes or newlines silently corrupted the JS object in the HTML attribute. Fixed with index-based onclick pattern: window._safetyTabSessions[] + numeric index.

recentChanges.name: Feature: Per-file heat-map in SAFETY tab
recentChanges.summary: Heat-map colors per file: green <10 lines, yellow 10–50, red >50, purple rewrites (>200 or removed/added>70%). track-usage.sh switched from --name-only to --numstat to capture +N/-M per file.

recentChanges.name: Feature: Prompt capture hook (on-user-prompt.sh)
recentChanges.summary: on-user-prompt.sh captures first 200 chars of each user message and appends to .session-prompts-tmp. track-usage.sh consumes this file at session stop and stores prompts in llm-usage.json activity.prompts[].

recentChanges.name: Feature: 3-layer memory write enforcement
recentChanges.summary: Added 4 helper scripts (add-decision.sh, add-task.sh, add-pattern.sh, update-context.sh). Added 5 mandatory trigger events to CLAUDE.md. Cross-session debt hook catches missed writes and fires a reminder at next session start.
